title: Istio故障：通用前缀遮住特定API路由
body:
## 操作任务
实现task.py的repair(policy)，固定VirtualService包含fallback前缀/到v1以及后续api前缀/api到v2；只将api移动到fallback之前，返回深拷贝，不改其他字段。实际istioctl应先报告IST0131重叠，修复后不再报告；真实Envoy按同一规则顺序重现API误到v1，修复后API到v2而普通路径仍到v1。

## 产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；真实istioctl和私有Envoy验证规则先后与两个后端。

## 能力边界
真实istioctl1.31.3本地分析及真实Envoy1.36.13私有回环代理；Envoy路由由题目按两条VirtualService规则直接构造，用于验证首匹配语义，不是通过Istio控制面下发的xDS，也没有真实网格或生产业务。所有进程在普通student新建user/net namespace中，未构建或拉取镜像，未变更默认身份。
answer: 将更具体/api规则放到通用/之前，保持目的子集和其他路由字段；再核对实际网格配置及请求结果。
explanation: VirtualService HTTP规则按顺序匹配；配置可解析不代表后面的重叠规则会被执行。
rubric: 真实分析器报告并消除重叠，实际代理API与其他路径到达各自后端，输入及字段不变。
review_note: 原模块故障场景真实缺口，新增题号绑定冻结空名额；不计原214故障和旧题改编。

exercise.operation: 只调整特定API规则与通用规则的次序并验证两个真实后端。
exercise.validation_scope: 真实istioctl1.31.3本地分析及真实Envoy1.36.13私有回环代理；Envoy路由由题目按两条VirtualService规则直接构造，用于验证首匹配语义，不是通过Istio控制面下发的xDS，也没有真实网格或生产业务。所有进程在普通student新建user/net namespace中，未构建或拉取镜像，未变更默认身份。

test_files.checks/check.py:
import hashlib,os,pathlib,subprocess,sys
assert os.getuid()==1000
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
assert hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path('base.yaml').read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='691465b4e65756e3f3d5e876456173e66acd4e6c889e0294132070a789103187'
assert hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path('policy.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='e9a71795bc709d6b8d794fb5661b5e1cf25a96ec64aeddda0ceb1051d0018f78'
before=os.readlink('/proc/self/ns/net');p=subprocess.run(['unshare','-Urn','--',sys.executable,'-B','checks/route_worker.py'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=35)
print(p.stdout,flush=True);assert p.returncode==0,p.stdout+p.stderr;assert os.readlink('/proc/self/ns/net')==before
assert 'NATIVE_ISTIO_ANALYZER_SHADOW_REMOVED_AND_REAL_ENVOY_API_AND_FALLBACK_DIFFERENT_UPSTREAMS' in p.stdout
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
test_files.checks/route_worker.py:
import copy,json,os,pathlib,subprocess,sys,tempfile
sys.path[:0]=[str(pathlib.Path.cwd()),str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/'checks')]
import task
from envoy_fixture import Envoy,Upstream,bootstrap,hcm
assert os.getuid()==0
subprocess.run(['ip','link','set','lo','up'],check=True,capture_output=True)
policy=json.loads(pathlib.Path('policy.json').read_bytes());original=copy.deepcopy(policy)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='of-istio-route-') as name,Upstream(status=200) as v1,Upstream(status=201) as v2:
 root=pathlib.Path(name);kube=root/'kubeconfig';kube.write_text(json.dumps({'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'Config','clusters':[],'contexts':[],'users':[],'current-context':''}))
 def analyze(obj):
  target=root/'policy.json';target.write_text(json.dumps(obj));p=subprocess.run(['istioctl','analyze','--use-kube=false','--kubeconfig',str(kube),'--namespace','mesh-training','--failure-threshold','Error',str(pathlib.Path('base.yaml').resolve()),str(target)],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=15)
  assert p.returncode==0,p.stdout+p.stderr;return p.stdout+p.stderr
 def envoy_config(obj):
  config=bootstrap(v1.port);clusters=config['static_resources']['clusters'];clusters[0]['name']='v1';clusters[0]['load_assignment']['cluster_name']='v1';second=copy.deepcopy(clusters[0]);second['name']='v2';second['load_assignment']['cluster_name']='v2';second['load_assignment']['endpoints'][0]['lb_endpoints'][0]['endpoint']['address']['socket_address']['port_value']=v2.port;clusters.append(second)
  hcm(config)['route_config']['virtual_hosts'][0]['routes']=[{'match':{'prefix':r['match'][0]['uri']['prefix']},'route':{'cluster':r['route'][0]['destination']['subset'],'timeout':'1s'}} for r in obj['spec']['http']]
  return config
 before=analyze(policy);assert 'IST0131' in before and 'api' in before,before
 with Envoy(envoy_config(policy)) as e:assert e.request('/api/book')[0]==200 and e.request('/other')[0]==200
 print('NATIVE_ISTIO_ANALYZER_IST0131_AND_REAL_ENVOY_FALLBACK_SHADOWS_API',flush=True)
 print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:move_specific_approved_route_before_catchall',flush=True)
 try:fixed=task.repair(policy)
 except Exception as error:raise AssertionError('approved route ordering repair failed') from error
 expected=copy.deepcopy(original);expected['spec']['http']=[expected['spec']['http'][1],expected['spec']['http'][0]]
 assert policy==original and fixed==expected,'only the approved rule order may change'
 after=analyze(fixed);assert 'IST0131' not in after,after
 with Envoy(envoy_config(fixed)) as e:assert e.request('/api/book')[0]==201 and e.request('/other')[0]==200
 assert len(v1.requests)==3 and len(v2.requests)==1
 print('NATIVE_ISTIO_ANALYZER_SHADOW_REMOVED_AND_REAL_ENVOY_API_AND_FALLBACK_DIFFERENT_UPSTREAMS',flush=True)
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
